title: Einsatz / Signature Graphics
slide_intent: Choose a graphic’s scale and density according to its job so accents and backgrounds do not compete.
strategic_value: A controlled range can let DB graphics support both concise and expansive layouts.
demonstration: Two layout diagrams compare a single lilac accent with a pale skyline containing one red focal landmark.
practical_value: Use graphics as a single accent or combined background; preserve equal scaling when several share one surface.

content_islands.name: Usage rules
content_islands.spec: Place the placement, cropping and scaling instructions above the examples.

content_islands.name: Accent and field
content_islands.spec: Pair the single-graphic layout with the multi-graphic background layout.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples demonstrate accent and full-surface use, including cropped placement.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Multiple signature graphics on one surface must use the same scale.
